opis: Ko so se Sparrowi prisiljeni pridružiti Bransonovim na maščevalni misiji, morajo hitro ukrepati, da bi rešili Bottomleyjeve. Lisa prejme dokaz, ki preteklost pokaže v povsem novi luči. 2/6
igralci: Lorraine Ashbourne (Daphne Sparrow), David Morrissey (DCS Ian St Clair), Perry Fitzpatrick (Rory Sparrow), Philip Jackson (Mickey Sparrow), Adam Hugill (Scott Rowley), Lesley Manville (Julie Jackson), Bill Jones (Ronan Sparrow), Claire Rushbrook (Cathy Rowley), Michael Balogun (Harry Summers), Christine Bottomley (Rachel Crossley)
